feedback.problem:
A mail truck departs from the post office at the origin and drives with a constant velocity of $(4i-3j)\,\text{mi/h}.$ Determine the distance $(|r|)$ from the truck to the origin after $2$ hours.

$\,|r|=$
{{field-1}}
$\text{mi}$
feedback.worked_solution:
If a particle moves with constant velocity $u,$ the position vector of the particle at time $t$ can be found using

$$
r={r}_{0}+ut,
$$

where ${r}_{0}$ is the initial position of the particle.

In our case, we have

$$
{r}_{0}=0i+0j,\,u=4i-3j.
$$

Therefore, the position vector of the truck after $t=2\,\text{h}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & ={r}_{0}+ut \\  & =(0i+0j)+(4i-3j)(2) \\  & =(8i-6j)\,\text{mi}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, the distance from the truck to the origin at this time is

$$
\begin{aligned}|r| & =|8i-6j| \\  & =\sqrt{{8}^{2}+(-6)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{64+36} \\  & =\sqrt{100} \\  & =10\,\text{mi}.\end{aligned}
$$
